plain.li: {PAWN_nameDef} opens with "Don't take this the wrong way."
{PAWN_nameDef} waits until the room is full, so there are witnesses.
{PAWN_nameDef} started to say this twice at lunch and stopped both times.
{PAWN_nameDef} falls into step beside whoever is headed out to the fields.
{PAWN_nameDef} apologizes twice before getting to the point.
{PAWN_nameDef} keeps it short.
[trait:Brawler] {PAWN_nameDef} cracks {PAWN_possessive} knuckles before asking, out of habit.
[trait:Wimp] Half hidden behind the doorframe, {PAWN_nameDef} asks, ready to back away at the first sign of a no.
[trait:Tough] {PAWN_nameDef} has a fresh gash along one arm and hasn't mentioned it.
[trait:TooSmart] {PAWN_nameDef} has scratched a diagram into the dirt to explain it, with arrows.
[trait:Masochist] {PAWN_nameDef} seems faintly disappointed to be asking for something that would make life easier.
[trait:Undergrounder,outside] {PAWN_nameDef} squints at the open sky and keeps it short, eager to get back under a roof.
[trait:NightOwl,morning|day] Up at an hour {PAWN_pronoun} considers the middle of the night, {PAWN_nameDef} skips the pleasantries.
[trait:Recluse] {PAWN_nameDef} waits until there's only one person nearby before asking.
[trait:Gourmand] {PAWN_nameDef} brings it up while eyeing someone else's plate.
[trait:Psychopath] {PAWN_nameDef} asks politely, then watches each face in turn while waiting for an answer.
[trait:Kind] {PAWN_nameDef} asks how the others' days went, and listens, before getting around to it.
[skill:Artistic] {PAWN_nameDef} sketches what {PAWN_pronoun} means on the nearest flat surface while talking.
[skill:Social] {PAWN_nameDef} makes the request sound like it was the council's idea all along.
[skill:Shooting] {PAWN_nameDef} says it slowly and evenly, the way {PAWN_pronoun} breathes out before a shot.
[grieving] {PAWN_nameDef} has barely spoken since the loss. This is the first thing {PAWN_pronoun} has asked for in days.
[grieving,night] {PAWN_nameDef} can't sleep and won't say why, so {PAWN_pronoun} talks about this instead.
[hurt,afterraid] The stitches are fresh and {PAWN_nameDef} is the color of old porridge, but {PAWN_pronoun} limps over anyway.
[winter,night] Most of the colony is asleep, so {PAWN_nameDef} makes the case to whoever's on watch, keeping {PAWN_possessive} voice down.
[summer,hot] {PAWN_nameDef} slaps at a fly on {PAWN_possessive} neck, misses, and gets to the point.
[spring,rain] {PAWN_nameDef} tracks spring mud across the floor and starts talking before anyone can complain about it.
[spacer] {PAWN_nameDef} has written the request out on a datapad, with footnotes.
[medieval] {PAWN_nameDef} stands up at the table, uninvited, and speaks loud enough to rattle the cups.
[tribal] {PAWN_nameDef} waits for the storyteller to finish, then tells a much shorter story that ends in a request.
[doubtful] {PAWN_nameDef} asks while looking at the floor, as if the answer's already been given.
[teen] {PAWN_nameDef} says it fast, arms crossed, and dares anyone to make a thing of it.
[child,night] {PAWN_nameDef} is supposed to be in bed, and has padded out barefoot to ask.
[old,winter] {PAWN_nameDef} felt this cold in {PAWN_possessive} knees three days before it came, and is in no mood to wait.
[newcomer] {PAWN_nameDef} is still learning everyone's names, but has already worked out what's missing.
[rich] {PAWN_nameDef} has noticed the full storerooms, and noticed who isn't benefiting from them.
[trigger:raid] {PAWN_nameDef} still has {PAWN_possessive} weapon in hand when {PAWN_pronoun} starts talking.
[trigger:raid] {PAWN_nameDef} has to step over a dead raider to reach the door.
[trigger:raid,hurt] Bleeding through a fresh bandage, {PAWN_nameDef} refuses to lie down until this is said.
[trigger:death] Someone has laid a blanket over the body. {PAWN_nameDef} keeps straightening the corners.
[trigger:death] {PAWN_nameDef} hasn't eaten since the death. The bowl beside {PAWN_objective} has gone cold twice.
[trigger:death,afterraid] The raid cost the colony one of its own. {PAWN_nameDef} wants this last part done right.
[trigger:cold] {PAWN_nameDef} slept in every piece of clothing {PAWN_pronoun} owns and still woke up with numb fingers.
[trigger:cold] {PAWN_nameDef} woke with frost in {PAWN_possessive} eyebrows and hasn't warmed up since.
[trigger:cold,lowtech] {PAWN_nameDef} spent the night curled against the dying embers, and there's soot on {PAWN_possessive} face.
[trigger:heat] {PAWN_nameDef} tried sleeping on the bare floor to keep cool, and didn't sleep at all.
[trigger:heat] {PAWN_nameDef} dragged {PAWN_possessive} bedroll outside last night to escape the heat, and woke up covered in bites.
[trigger:heat,summer] By midday the air indoors shimmers, and {PAWN_nameDef} comes out of it wringing {PAWN_possessive} shirt.
[trigger:floor] {PAWN_nameDef} eats standing up again, bowl balanced on one palm, and loses patience halfway through.
[trigger:floor] There's grit from the floor in {PAWN_nameDef}'s stew again.
[trigger:floor,old] {PAWN_nameDef} gets up from another meal on the floor in three slow, noisy stages.
[trigger:barracks] {PAWN_nameDef} spent half the night listening to the barracks cough and turn over.
[trigger:barracks] {PAWN_nameDef} was kicked awake twice in the barracks last night.
[trigger:barracks,winter] The barracks is warm, at least, the way a crowded stable is warm. {PAWN_nameDef} would trade it for a cold room with a door.
[trigger:rawfood] {PAWN_nameDef} picks a stringy bit of something raw out of {PAWN_possessive} teeth and looks around for someone to blame.
[trigger:rawfood] {PAWN_nameDef} has been chewing the same raw mouthful for a while now, and it isn't getting any smaller.
[trigger:rawfood,lowmood] {PAWN_nameDef} eats raw food with the flat face of someone who has stopped expecting better.
[trigger:sick] {PAWN_nameDef} spent the night bent over a bucket, and has come out the other side with strong opinions about the kitchen.
[trigger:sick] Gray-faced and unsteady, {PAWN_nameDef} grips the doorframe with one hand and talks about the cooking.
[trigger:sick] {PAWN_nameDef} sniffs {PAWN_possessive} lunch, pushes it away, and goes to find someone to talk to.
[trigger:dark] {PAWN_nameDef} has a bruise on one shin shaped exactly like the corner of a bed.
[trigger:dark] {PAWN_nameDef} spent ten minutes feeling for {PAWN_possessive} own bed in the dark last night, and found the wall three times first.
[trigger:dark,night] {PAWN_nameDef} feels {PAWN_possessive} way out of a room as black as pitch, blinking at the light.
[trigger:naked] {PAWN_nameDef} arrives wrapped in a blanket, with as much dignity as a blanket allows.
[trigger:naked] {PAWN_nameDef} has tied a sack round {PAWN_possessive} waist and is not smiling.
[trigger:naked,cold] Teeth chattering and covered in goosebumps, {PAWN_nameDef} makes the case for clothes.
[trigger:cabin] {PAWN_nameDef} has paced the same room so often there's nearly a groove in the floor.
[trigger:cabin] {PAWN_nameDef} has rearranged {PAWN_possessive} few belongings four times today.
[trigger:cabin,winter] Snowed in for days, {PAWN_nameDef} has started counting the cracks in the ceiling out loud.
[trigger:corpse] {PAWN_nameDef} has been walking the long way around the body outside for two days.
[trigger:corpse] Flies have found the body outside. {PAWN_nameDef} comes in waving them off.
[trigger:corpse,hot] The body outside has been lying in the sun for days. {PAWN_nameDef} talks with a sleeve pressed over {PAWN_possessive} nose.
[trigger:envy] {PAWN_nameDef} congratulated {ENVIED_nameDef} warmly, then went off and brooded about it all afternoon.
[trigger:envy] {PAWN_nameDef} has been stiffly polite to {ENVIED_nameDef} all day.
[trigger:envy,trait:Jealous] {PAWN_nameDef} has said "good for {ENVIED_objective}" four times today, each time with less conviction.
[trigger:injury] {PAWN_nameDef} has been learning new ways to do old things, and is tired of having to.
[trigger:injury] {PAWN_nameDef} keeps forgetting about the missing {SUBJECT}, then remembering again, all day long.
[trigger:injury] {PAWN_nameDef} watches the others work for a while, then gets up, awkwardly, and asks.
{FOR_nameDef} doesn't say anything at first.
{FOR_nameDef} takes it in, then goes off to tell someone who already knows.
{FOR_nameDef} thanks the council, then says it again under {FOR_possessive} breath.
Later, someone catches {FOR_nameDef} grinning at it.
[trait:Greedy] {FOR_nameDef} is pleased, and already visibly drafting the next request.
[trait:Jealous] {FOR_nameDef} makes sure the others notice, especially the ones who got theirs first.
[trait:Ascetic] {FOR_nameDef} seems almost embarrassed to be given anything, and thanks the council too quickly.
[trigger:raid] {FOR_nameDef} stops looking over {FOR_possessive} shoulder long enough to say thank you.
[trigger:death] {FOR_nameDef} goes off alone for a while before coming back to work.
[trigger:cold] {FOR_nameDef} peels off a layer, then another.
[trigger:naked] {FOR_nameDef} gets dressed slowly and with great dignity.
[trigger:floor] {FOR_nameDef} pulls up a seat at the new table and sets {FOR_possessive} bowl down on it.
[promised] {FOR_nameDef} finds whoever made the promise and nods once.
[petition] The ones who asked for it congratulate each other as though they'd done the work themselves.
[forother] {FOR_nameDef} finds {PAWN_nameDef} afterward, and neither of them quite knows what to say.
[lowmood] {FOR_nameDef}'s shoulders come down from around {FOR_possessive} ears.
[child] {FOR_nameDef} goes around telling the animals about it, one by one.
[repeat] It took asking more than once, and {FOR_nameDef} lets that go.
I'm not saying {ENVIED_nameDef} didn't deserve it. I'm saying I noticed.
[trait:Jealous] I've been keeping track, and {ENVIED_nameDef} is ahead of me now.

warm.li: {ENVIED_nameDef} was so pleased, and I thought, I'd like to feel that too.
I hope this doesn't sound petty. {ENVIED_nameDef}'s good luck made me notice what I've been doing without.

blunt.li: {ENVIED_nameDef} got one. {ENVIED_nameDef} is not special.
If {ENVIED_nameDef} can have one, so can I.

cheerful.li: {ENVIED_nameDef} hasn't stopped talking about it, and now I've caught it too!
You should have seen {ENVIED_nameDef}'s face. I'd like a turn at that!

gloomy.li: {ENVIED_nameDef} has one now. I've tried not to think about it.
I'll ask, though I'm used to hearing no.

cold.li: I've been watching {ENVIED_nameDef} enjoy it.
I don't object to what {ENVIED_nameDef} received. I object to being the exception.

plain.li: All right, I'll stop bringing it up.
Good, that's one thing off my mind and onto yours.

warm.li: Thank you, and don't worry, I know there's a lot to do first.
That's kind of you, with everything else on your plate.

blunt.li: Good, now I've got witnesses.
You said it out loud, so it counts.

cheerful.li: Promised, promised, I heard it, everybody heard it!
I'm going to be insufferable about this until it happens, just so you know.

gloomy.li: I'll try to believe you, but I've been promised things before.
A promise is better than a no, I suppose.

cold.li: I've made a note of the date you promised.
Then I'll consider the matter scheduled.

plain.li: Right, well, I'll stop hoping for it.
Fair enough, I've gone without before.

warm.li: That's all right, others here need things more than I do.
No hard feelings, you've got all of us to think about.

blunt.li: Then don't ask me to stand the night watch either.
You didn't even let me finish.

cheerful.li: No it is, and next time I'll ask for less!
Well, my hopes were up, and now they can go and lie down!

gloomy.li: Figures, I was disappointed before I even asked.
I'll add it to the list of things I'm not getting.

cold.li: Very well, the colony can expect one less favor from me.
A clear answer, which is more than most people give.

plain.li: Still waiting on "{WISH}", in case anyone's lost track.
[repeat] Yes, I'm asking about "{WISH}" again.

warm.li: Sorry to bring it up again, I know you're all busy.
If there's ever a quiet day, I'm still hoping.

blunt.li: I'm going to keep saying it until somebody does it.
Am I talking to myself here, or is someone writing this down?

cheerful.li: Hi, it's me, the one who asked for the thing, still asking!
Me again, and I'm not going anywhere!

gloomy.li: I keep mentioning it, and it keeps not happening, and here we are.
I'm sure it's on a list somewhere, near the bottom.

cold.li: I'm raising this again because it has not been resolved.
Every day this waits costs you some of my goodwill.

plain.li: I'm nearly out of patience with this.
After this, I stop asking and start doing without.

warm.li: I've tried so hard not to be a bother, but I need you to hear me on this one.
I'm not angry yet, and I'd really like to keep it that way.

blunt.li: Last time I'm asking nicely.
Time's nearly up, so do it or tell me no.

cheerful.li: My smile is still on, but it's getting very tired!
One more cheerful reminder, and that's my last!

gloomy.li: I knew it would come to this.
Soon I'll stop asking, and I doubt anyone will notice.

cold.li: Consider this formal notice.
This is the last time I take it to the council.

plain.li: I've started on it myself, which is quicker than waiting.
It might not be pretty when it's finished, but it's mine to worry about now.

warm.li: I hope you don't mind. I didn't want anyone else to have to stop what they were doing.
I've made a start on my own, so please don't feel bad about it.

blunt.li: I'll sort it out myself, then.
I've started it myself, so stay out of my way.

cheerful.li: Who needs a council? I've got two hands and a plan!
I'm doing it myself, and I've got a plan and everything!

gloomy.li: I stopped waiting for help that wasn't coming.
I'll do it myself, and it'll show.

cold.li: The council's delay was noted, and bypassed.
The council may consider itself unnecessary in this instance.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s request is done, and mine is still waiting.
I suppose I'll keep waiting while the others get served first.

warm.li: I'm happy for {OTHER_nameDef}, I really am, but it stings.
{OTHER_nameDef} must have needed it more, and mine can wait.

blunt.li: So that's the order now: {OTHER_nameDef} first, me never.
I asked before {OTHER_nameDef} did, and everyone here knows it.

cheerful.li: Good for {OTHER_nameDef}, and better for me when it's my turn!
I'm cheering for {OTHER_nameDef} with one hand and pointing at myself with the other.

gloomy.li: Being skipped doesn't get easier, even when you're used to it.
{OTHER_nameDef} got lucky, and I got older.

cold.li: So {OTHER_nameDef}'s request outranks mine, and I'll remember the ranking.
So seniority counts for nothing here.

plain.li: You looked me in the eye and promised, and I believed you.
I'll never take a promise from this council at face value again.

warm.li: I kept telling the others you'd come through, and now I look like a fool.
I'm not going to shout, I just want you to know it hurt.

blunt.li: Next time, don't promise, just say no, it's quicker.
That's the last promise of yours I listen to.

cheerful.li: Well, that's the last time I get excited about a promise!
I'd told the others it was coming, too!

gloomy.li: Should have known, promises out here rot faster than meat.
I let myself hope, which was my mistake, not yours.

cold.li: Your promise has been reclassified as a lie.
I won't make the mistake of relying on your word again.

plain.li: Another council meeting, another round of nodding and nothing.
I stopped asking for things around the time I stopped expecting them.

warm.li: I keep trying to see the best in this place, and it keeps making that difficult.
These days I'm too tired to be angry about it.

blunt.li: I'd get better answers from the livestock.
Don't tell me to take it to the council.

cheerful.li: Hello to everyone except the council!
I've learned to love low expectations, and the council never lets me down.

gloomy.li: Whatever I want, I'll keep it to myself from now on.
There's no point asking, there never was.

cold.li: The council has demonstrated its priorities, and I am not among them.
I've stopped putting anything into the council, since it pays nothing back.

plain.li: Find a seat {VENUE}, everyone. This might take a while.
Order, everyone, order, and that includes the back row.
[night] It's late, so let's keep it to one argument each.
[poor] Somebody fetch another crate to sit on, and then we'll start.
[winter|cold] Gather in close, it's freezing, and we're not leaving until we've decided.

warm.li: Sit and rest your feet first, you've all had a long day.

blunt.li: Sit down, stop chewing, and wait your turn.

cheerful.li: Council time, my favorite part of the whole day!

gloomy.li: Well, we're all still alive, so I suppose we'd better talk about what comes next.

cold.li: This meeting will be brief, and interruptions will be remembered.

plain.li: I've wanted "{AMBITION}" for a season, and I'm glad someone finally said it.
Whatever it costs, it'll cost more to keep doing without.

warm.li: If it helps even one of us sleep easier, it's worth it.
I'll help with "{AMBITION}", and I'll take the worst jobs.

blunt.li: It's the only idea here that isn't stupid, so yes.
Fine, "{AMBITION}", yes, now can we eat?

cheerful.li: I'm voting yes so hard my seat might break!
Yes, yes, a hundred times yes to "{AMBITION}"!

gloomy.li: It won't fix everything, but "{AMBITION}" might fix one thing.
It's the least hopeless thing I've heard in a while.

cold.li: Of the options, this one gets the fewest of us killed.
I've done the sums, and this one comes out ahead.

plain.li: Sounds lovely, but who's paying for it, and with what?
I like it in theory, but in theory we'd have a roof that doesn't leak.

warm.li: I'm sure {OTHER_nameDef} means well, but can we really manage it right now?
Could we sleep on it before we commit to "{AMBITION}"?

blunt.li: I've heard better ideas from a boomalope, right before it exploded.
No, and if {OTHER_nameDef} keeps talking, it's still no.

cheerful.li: Ooh, a terrible idea, my favorite kind, but no!
I'd vote yes if I could work out what it actually means!

gloomy.li: Every plan we've made out here has gone wrong somewhere along the way.
It'll take twice as long as {OTHER_nameDef} says.

cold.li: It costs too much for what it gives back, and I've checked twice.
I'll vote against it, and I'd advise {OTHER_nameDef} not to take that personally.

plain.li: Whose turn is it to wash the bowls? Because it isn't mine.
Does anyone else hear that scratching in the walls?
Somebody's foot is touching my foot, and I'd like to know whose.
[rain] The roof's dripping right on my seat, same as last time.
[storm] That flash was close, I only got to three.
[snow] Somebody's boots are melting into a puddle, and it's spreading toward me.
[cold,lowtech] Someone put another log on the fire, I can't feel my fingers.
[night] Who's on watch tonight, if we're all in here?
[trait:Gourmand] Is anyone going to finish that?
[trait:NightOwl] This is the first meeting I've been properly awake for.
[trait:Jealous] Why does {OTHER_nameDef} get the good chair?
[trait:Recluse] I'll need a week on my own after this many people.
[trait:Bloodlust] Shame we're voting, a fight would settle it quicker.
[trait:TooSmart] I already know how the vote goes, so I'm only here for the arguing.
[trait:Masochist] I like how hard this bench is.
[trait:Wimp] If anyone raises their voice, I'm leaving.
[skill:Cooking] Whoever salted the stew, we need to talk after this.
[skill:Medicine] Anyone feeling feverish? You, you look feverish. Sit over there.
[skill:Mining] I found a good seam today, and I'd rather be digging it out than sitting here.
[skill:Plants] The crops won't harvest themselves, you know.
[skill:Shooting] Somebody's moved my weapon, and I will find out who.
[skill:Social] Three of you are lying about how you'll vote, and I know which three.
[skill:Artistic] The shadows on that wall would make a good painting.
[skill:Intellectual] There's a moth on the ceiling I've never seen before.
[child] Why are grown-ups so loud when they agree?
[teen] Wake me up when you've decided.
[old] I've buried better councils than this one.
[grieving] Please leave that seat empty.
[afterraid] I still can't hear out of my left ear, so if you're voting, wave.
[hurt] Talk faster, my stitches itch.
[poor] We could sell this table and eat for a week, I'm just saying.

warm.li: Has everyone had something to eat? There's more in the pot.

blunt.li: Some of you should talk less. Most of you.

cheerful.li: I love this, everyone squashed in together, arguing!

gloomy.li: Every meeting, I count heads. One day the count will be lower.

cold.li: If this runs much longer, I'm going to start ranking all of you.
